gen-gf-goldman-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu reads friendly and unhurried, its wide, tall bowls leaving hooks open instead of latching shut. Goldman is the one for commanding, widely spaced display lines, while Anek Telugu does the quieter work as a plain sans.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-anuphan: Round and friendly, Anuphan fills its lowercase with big bowls and curves that keep clear gaps, under a bold Goldman heading. Text stays easy going.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-arimo: Arimo reads with a tall mean line and generous gaps at the ends of its rounded letters, a sturdy sans-serif. Goldman earns its place big and brief.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-armata: Goldman's lowercase stands unusually tall against its capitals, and its round forms look like open parentheses. Armata keeps its own lowercase large and its curves spacious, a plain sans that quietly carries the reading while Goldman commands.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-athiti: Goldman sets wide, bold letters with generous clearance and a tall lowercase, a sharp display voice. Athiti follows with a single line width like cut vinyl, so its s stays see-through and the text moves along easily.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Atkinson Hyperlegible reads friendly and direct, with wide-set terminals on the s and capitals that feel clipped beside the lowercase. Atkinson Hyperlegible keeps that distinct character across a long stretch, a quiet sans-serif beneath Goldman's bold, wide headline.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-biryani: Biryani reads open and approachable, with a large eye on every e and counters that never clog. Biryani keeps one stroke width throughout, so a heading made small would lose Goldman's wide, commanding stance.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-blinker: Goldman brings wide, bold letters and round forms like open parentheses, with a tall lowercase. Blinker holds one steady line from top to baseline, a friendly sans with open apertures, and a heading this wide likes plenty of room.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-carrois-gothic: Bold and wide, Goldman leads with a tall lowercase and round forms that look like open parentheses. Carrois Gothic keeps text modern and easy to follow.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Approachable describes Carrois Gothic SC, whose curves end in clear openings and whose lowercase barely differs from capital height. Goldman does its best work commanding attention with wide, bold letters, and Carrois Gothic SC does its best work as a quiet sans-serif underneath.
